充值档位积分必须为正整数，赠送积分不能为负数: Recharge tier points must be positive integers and bonus points cannot be negative.
充值档位积分不能重复: Recharge tier points cannot be duplicated.
易支付 V1 / V2；回调只确认收到，不参与入账: EPay V1 / V2. Callbacks only trigger verification and never credit balances.
粘贴易支付生成的商户私钥（Base64 或 PEM，保存后不回显）: Paste the merchant private key generated by EPay (Base64 or PEM). It is not returned after saving.
粘贴易支付商户中心显示的平台公钥，不是商户公钥: Paste the platform public key shown in the EPay merchant console, not the merchant public key.
已保存密钥不会回显；留空保持不变: Saved keys are not displayed. Leave blank to keep the existing key.
输入 TLD 后回车: Enter a TLD and press Enter
系统默认使用 Public Suffix List；这里仅填写需要人工补充的公共: The system uses the Public Suffix List by default. Add only missing public suffixes here, such as edu.kg.
根域名本身不计入限额: The registrable domain itself does not count toward the limit.
配置支付宝积分汇率、最低充值积分、手续费和前端充值档位: Configure the Alipay point exchange rate, minimum recharge points, fees, and recharge tiers.
仅创建支付宝订单时用于把积分换算为人民币: Used only to convert points into RMB when creating an Alipay order
千分之六请输入 0.6: Enter 0.6 for a 0.6% fee (six per thousand).
单用户最大未支付充值订单数: Maximum unpaid recharge orders per user
逐项设置前端积分和对应赠送积分，赠送为 0 表示不赠送: Set each customer-facing point tier and its bonus points. A bonus of 0 means no bonus.
配置被邀请用户首次充值后的返利比例、积分上限和有效期: Configure the rebate rate, point caps, and validity period after an invited user's first recharge.
暂无充值档位，请添加档位: No recharge tiers. Add one to continue.
回调后前 10 次每 5 秒查账，随后每 30 秒；无回调时 60 秒启动，5: After a callback, verify every 5 seconds for the first 10 attempts, then every 30 seconds. Without a callback, start after 60 seconds and stop after 5 minutes.
新建或审批项目时自动带入，可在项目管理中继续调整: Applied automatically when a project is created or approved; prices remain editable in project management.
用户每天首次打开页面或进入数据看板时，按上海日期自动签到并抽取一次奖励: Automatically check users in once per Shanghai day when they open the app or visit the data dashboard.
每行积分必须为整数，是该档范围上限；按积分从高到低，相邻档位组成左开右闭范围，最: Each value must be an integer upper bound. Adjacent values form (lower, upper] ranges in descending order, the lowest tier is fixed, and each tier's actual probability is its weight divided by the total weight.
各档实际概率 = 本档权重 ÷ 总权重: Actual tier probability = tier weight / total weight
签到奖励积分必须为正整数，权重必须大于 0，积分档位不能重复: Reward points must be positive integers, weights must be positive, and tier point values must be unique.
按上海自然日统计成功订单，结算后自动入账并向获奖用户发送系统通知邮件: Count successful orders by Shanghai calendar day, credit winners after settlement, and send a system notification email.
可配置单名次或连续名次范围，例如第 3 至第 6 名使用同一奖励: Configure one rank or a consecutive range, such as ranks 3 through 6 sharing one reward.
排行榜名次范围不能重叠，且奖励积分必须大于 0: Rank ranges cannot overlap, and reward points must be positive.
签到成功，本次未获得积分奖励: Check-in successful. No point reward this time.
